scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run gen && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm -r run gen && pnpm -r run test
scripts.dev: pnpm -r run gen && dotenvx run -- pnpm -r --parallel run dev
scripts.build: pnpm -r run gen && dotenvx run -- pnpm -r run build
scripts.staging: pnpm run build && dotenvx run -- pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run staging
scripts.build:frontend: pnpm -r run gen && dotenvx run -- pnpm run --filter=frontend build:prod
